notes.title: Play the Demo of The Flower Collectors!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/4a97411dc8246fa98dcaa6cf312d4b253066da67.gif

If you haven't gotten the chance to play The Flower Collectors yet, now's your chance. 
We have made a demo version in which you can play the first chapters of our game for free. Get a taste of 1970s Barcelona from Jorge's balcony, and witness the beginning of the murder mystery. 🔍

Play it here on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/8ccf2e5f8457f2ab7f6c5e953a77e6b75e4cfb0d.jpg

What's next?
Last month, our team went on a mountain hike to get a spark of inspiration for an upcoming project. We climbed the 2076m high Schneeberg, 2 hours drive away from Vienna. We would love to tell you all about our secret new project, but for now we can only give you this hint. 
Keep a close eye on our channels for more news:

Follow us on Twitter or subscribe to our newsletter!

notes.title: The Flower Collectors Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the Original Soundtrack of The Flower Collectors is now available on Steam! 

All songs are composed and arranged by the Austrian composer Florian Spies. We hope that listening to the jazz tunes will bring you back to 1970s Barcelona. 

The soundtrack is also available as a bundle with the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/5e5598284b13c6d80ff9ad7514da854eb7cfd542.png


Enjoy a wallpaper for desktop and mobile
To celebrate the 1 month anniversary of The Flower Collectors, we made a new wallpaper. You can download it on the website. It's available for both desktop and mobile resolutions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/8f0aea79f0b37be4f606356e45dee581d2deb2fb.png

Leave a review
Did you enjoy playing The Flower Collectors? We'd love to hear about it! 
Please consider leaving a review. 

This is extremely important for us, because it helps us reach new players. We'd appreciate it!

From Vienna with Love,
The Mipumi Team

notes.title: LudoNarraCon - The Flower Collectors Making of
notes.content:
Welcome to LudoNarraCon!

Thanks for joining us on this Behind-the-scenes special LudoNarraCon stream to learn more about the making of The Flower Collectors!

Stay tuned for insights about the art & character design, the decisions that drove the aesthetics & art style as well as the historic background of the post-Franco era in Spain in the 70s.


Dive into the world of detectives and murder mysteries in a Let's Play of the first 3 chapters with producer Eline, and see how two very diverse characters are thrown together in a common destiny
Listen to Tobe, lead designer, as he shares insights about character design, story background and gameplay features
Learn from senior artist David as he shows you our development tools and see how the art evolved from first concepts to the final game


How does the story unfold? Who are the protagonists aka suspects in this detective mystery set in the political powder-keg of Barcelona in 1977?

Enjoy the first glimpse of The Flower Collectors.

We are excited to share this behind-the-scenes look with you and would love to hear what you think! Leave a comment below this post or follow us on Twitter!

Your Mipumi Team

notes.title: The Flower Collectors is launching on 21st April!
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

We’ve got some truly exciting news to share: The Flower Collectors has an official release date! 

Jorge’s and Melinda’s adventure will start on the 21st April on PC and we truly can't wait for you to play the game! Here is a teaser trailer we made for the occasion:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uJnw7eoQa90

Meet new suspects!
In the latest update you got a sneak peak at the protagonists of the game. Like every good murder mystery, The Flower Collectors features both detectives and suspects. Today, we’re introducing you to a small part of the cast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/190ac90b9294480170f86bae21c11cc5ee197c4b.png
“The mechanics, Marietta and Luisa. Always busy... Anna said the lights in their workshop were on during the night of the murder.” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/a8adaf97d1b4f82d095fffa513c29c7f481a4b88.jpg
“Lola, the cabaret singer, has been frequenting the café across the plaza a lot lately. Why would she suddenly become such a loyal customer?” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ae984131eefba495343d336c8c5ec75a45860bc3.png
“Padre Eusebio is the head of the local church. All those confessions... he must have dirt on practically everyone around here.”

A little glimpse of gameplay
While we have previously shown you a few set pieces of our Barcelona 1977 setting, and now also introduced some of the suspects that inhibit the colourful city, today we also want to give you a first look teaser of how the gameplay of The Flower Collectors will look like.

While we don’t want to give away too much just now, we can say that the game will be played in a first-person perspective. You can even see Jorge's shadow & wheelchair when you look down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ae2f9610b4462877a2e7c184647bab40b91f6cd3.gif

From Jorge’s balcony you will be able to watch as day-to-day life plays out in the neighbourhood below, to piece together clues. One very handy tool for that will be a camera, which you’ll be able to use to take pictures as evidence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/5303a82c5ed2230bd4e76eaec40bde34f2ee3259.gif

Lastly, you will be able to pin pictures up on your evidence board to try to work out who the murderer might be. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/e1dac39af68d453d628663548ebfd015eaf2ce9f.gif

That’s it for today! We’ll be sharing more updates soon, and if you want to you can wishlist the game (which helps us a lot) or follow us on twitter for even more regular updates. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034750/The_Flower_Collectors/

From Vienna with love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team

notes.title: Meet the protagonists of The Flower Collectors! 🐻😼
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

Thanks a lot for the great support and feedback we got from announcing The Flower Collectors! 

Since then we’ve been busy working on the game, but of course also wanted to give you an update on the world of The Flower Collectors. 

Today we are finally ready to show you the protagonists of our detective adventure!

Meet Jorge & Melinda
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/8fa8ed51713ab65e326baee8a263185553f82009.png

In The Flower Collectors, you play as Jorge. 🐻

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/c8d03067eb7cb6c171493544f8355aaf72315c9a.jpg

Jorge is an ex-cop, in a wheelchair, struggling with his new life. From his balcony, Jorge watches the world go by. Above you can see his apartment which plays a big role in the game. 

When he witnesses a murder, he unwillingly becomes part of the mystery himself…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/19008f53ef4a303f21814b064f695acca5de9ff4.png

The second protagonist: Melinda 😼
An ambitious journalist, determined to uncover the truth.

We will reveal more characters from the game over the next weeks!


Great media feedback

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/bfb2c5d04d45189a2c461f3a4b1d04886a875617.jpg

Apart from your social media support we also got a great reply from media with articles from all over the world like Gamespew and Adventure Gamer (English), Jeuxvideo in France, 4Players in Germany, Eurogamer in Italy, Igromania in Russia and many more.

If you are a German speaker you can also  watch an interview with Mipumi CEO Gregor on Adventurecorner.

Mipumi Games is 11 years old!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990323/ad66bd913e33f6aff3ba557a1a21f5f4599b67c3.jpg

In other news, we had our 11 year anniversary last month, time flies! Many thanks for your ongoing support!

The Flower Collectors will be coming to Steam this year. We can’t wait to show you more. If you want to you can follow us on Twitter for even more regular updates. 


From Vienna with love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team
